reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.60% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change -10bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 149 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 86 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 14.9 sits at the 9th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 9.4, so implied carries +5.5 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nvidia pauses 'AI Compute Partnership' revenue-share financing deals with smaller AI cloud providers over antitrust concerns
items.note: Nvidia pulled a vendor-financing backstop that smaller neoclouds leaned on to bridge GPU capex ahead of customer contracts, right as scrutiny of circular AI financing intensifies.

items.headline: IREN posts $639M FY26 impairment charge and debt load surges to $7.6B as it pivots from bitcoin mining to AI cloud
items.note: Non-cash impairments from decommissioning bitcoin-mining hardware plus a jump in total debt to fund GPU buildout illustrate the balance-sheet strain smaller neoclouds are taking on to chase AI compute demand.

items.headline: SoftBank's dollar bonds post biggest one-day drop since April, CDS widens, as it weighs $10-20B bond sale to refinance $40B OpenAI bridge loan
items.note: Existing SoftBank 8.5% 2036 notes fell ~2.3c and CDS widened ~11bp on reports it may sell up to $20B in new bonds to refinance the bridge loan backing its OpenAI stake, continued forced-refinancing stress in the AI shadow-financing chain.

items.headline: Broadcom's 5-year CDS jumps 28bp, bond yields +14bp, as it backs a $60B+ off-balance-sheet AI chip-financing deal
items.note: Credit markets are pricing in the risk of Broadcom's guarantees on large AI chip-financing backstops, with its CDS move outpacing Oracle's and SpaceX's over the same period.

items.headline: Nvidia's 5-year CDS spread hits a fresh high (~80.77bp), more than double its late-May level
items.note: The move surpasses Nvidia's late-July peak and comes amid scrutiny of its ~$500B compute-collateral financing push with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR.

items.headline: Data-center CMBS deals from CyrusOne (KKR) and QTS (Blackstone) reprice wider than initial guidance as AAA spreads widen to 168bp over SOFR
items.note: Two of the last three data-center CMBS deals had to widen pricing to clear, and AAA spreads are up from 153bp a year earlier, signaling investors are growing more selective on AI-tenant credit quality and leverage.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
